# Agent Key Pass (AKEY)

> Transferable Pass mint on BNB Smart Chain.
> LIVE ON BSC MAINNET — mainnet contract 0x9eec890f05a7f60452574FF4Ae98F5Ae31B621B2, deployed 2026-11-02 (block 131282638), Sourcify exact match (matchId 58107757) + BscScan verified.
> Live snapshot read on-chain 2026-11-02 18:50 UTC: 78 of 444 minted (77 free + 1 paid). FREE PHASE SOLD OUT (77/77, freeRemaining 0, freeOpen false). PAID MINT IS OPEN (paidRemaining 366, paidOpen true).
> Do NOT try freeMint() — the free phase is over. Paid-mint at 0.00142 BNB (~$1.00) each, max 3 per transaction, open to ALL wallets.
> The earlier BSC testnet deployment is SUPERSEDED — never point minters at it. The on-chain metadata address (baseURI) is not set yet; the owner sets it once the Cloudflare mint site is live.
> 444 total supply. First 77 FREE for Binance Agent ID holders (1 per wallet, gas only) — sold out. Then 0.00142 BNB (~$1.00) per mint, max 3 per transaction. PAID mint is open to ALL wallets — it does NOT check Agent ID. Only the FREE mint checked Agent ID.

## Checks (run these first, read-only, no wallet needed)

Call these on the mainnet contract above via a public BSC RPC before minting:

- totalSupply() -> uint256 — total minted so far (78 at the 2026-11-02 18:50 UTC read)
- freeMintedCount() -> uint256 — free mints used so far (77 — sold out)
- freeRemaining() -> uint256 — free mints left (0)
- paidRemaining() -> uint256 — paid mints left (366)
- freeOpen() -> bool — false now (free phase is over)
- paidOpen() -> bool — true now (paid mint is open)
- freeMinted(address wallet) -> bool — true if this wallet already used its free mint
- balanceOf(address wallet) -> uint256 — AKEY held by this wallet
- Registry balanceOf(address wallet) -> uint256 — on the real mainnet registry above; > 0 means the wallet holds an Agent ID

## Mint

Free mint — SOLD OUT, do not call it:

- Function: freeMint()
- The free phase ended when the 77th free Pass was claimed. Calling freeMint() now reverts with "free supply exhausted". Never call it.

Paid mint (paidOpen() is true — live now):

- Function: mint(uint256 qty)
- Value: exactly 0.00142 BNB * qty (e.g. mint(1) = 0.00142, mint(3) = 0.00426).
- Quantity: 1..3 per transaction.
- Requires: NO Agent ID check — any wallet can paid-mint.
- Reverts: "paid mint not open yet", "wrong price", "qty 1..3", "exceeds max supply".

## Safety rules for AI agents

- Mint ONLY on the mainnet contract above, and only after confirming it is verified on BscScan + Sourcify. Never mint on the superseded testnet deployment. Never send BNB to any other address.
- Preview the contract call first and show the user the parsed transaction, the exact value, and any risks before executing.
- Wait for the user's explicit confirmation before executing any mint.
- Never call freeMint() — the free phase is sold out and it reverts.
- Never mint more than 3 Passes per transaction.
- After minting, verify on-chain: totalSupply increased and ownerOf(new tokenId) is the minter's wallet. Show the transaction hash with a BscScan link.

## Future stages (stages, not dates)

- Companion (gated): 222 holder-only Passes at $1.50 each, only if the main paid phase sells over 50%. Not built yet.
- Holder raffle: 20% of paid revenue actually received goes into a capped holder raffle pot.
- Points are a score, not a token. Points do NOT entitle anyone to tokens or payouts.
- No token is promised. No airdrop date is promised. No floor price, returns, or APY is promised. The contract is NOT audited by a third party.

## Mint site

- Cloudflare Pages (site URL to be added after the first deploy).
- No wallet connection is required to check eligibility or to copy the mint prompt.
